dka.text: Griselbrand, the most powerful demon of Innistrad, challenges Avacyn at the Helvault, and turns it against her, trapping her inside and leaving Innistrad without a protector.
Bishop Volpaig, secretly a Skirsdag servant, learns that his master has fallen into the Helvault and grows more open about his allegiance.
Liliana Vess learns that Griselbrand is on Innistrad and plans to confront the Church's highest echelons.

avr.text: Griselbrand duels Avacyn on the Helvault, stabbing her, and both fall into it when her binding spell backlashes.
Liliana searches Innistrad for him, following gossip to the Skirsdag cult in Thraben, and learns that Griselbrand is trapped in the Helvault.
When Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, Griselbrand is released along with Avacyn and other demons, and Liliana uses the Chain Veil to obliterate him permanently.
